text: ところでさ　だいごみ　って　なんだろ？
note: In Japanese the boy simply admits he doesn't know what だいごみ (醍醐味), the grown-up word he just used, means; it comes from a Buddhist term for the finest flavour of a refined dairy food. The English game replaces this with puns on "appeal" (orange peel, a ringing bell).
